tools.name: search_trips
tools.description: Find hotels, flights and flight-and-hotel packages on Vuelo for a destination, dates and number of travellers, within a budget. The results appear in the Vuelo card, where the traveller compares and books them: do not follow up with a question asking which one they want. Hotels are live; pass origin

tools.name: get_hotel_availability
tools.description: Live rooms and prices at ONE hotel the traveller already has in mind, for their dates and number of guests, without searching the whole town. Pass the reference you hold: a Vuelo hotel link (https://…/h/…), an offerId from an earlier Vuelo search, a Vuelo property_id (VHP_…) or a hotel id from a Vue

tools.name: get_offer
tools.description: Details, terms, photos and the payment options for one Vuelo offer, repriced live.

tools.name: change_package_flight
tools.description: For a flight-and-hotel package from search_trips: every other flight for the same route and dates, each priced as a package with the same stay, with what it costs each traveller more or less than the current flight. The Vuelo card uses this for its Change flight list; call it yourself when the trave

tools.name: book_trip
tools.description: Bookings are made under Vuelo's Booking Terms and Conditions (https://getvuelo.com/uk/legal/terms-of-booking-service/); the Vuelo card and pay page show them. tools.name: get_booking_progress
tools.description: Progress of the newest booking for an offer, or the newest booking of all, for the Vuelo widget.

tools.name: change_payment_option
tools.description: When the traveller wants to pay a different way (for example reserve now instead of paying in full) before they have confirmed. Switches the open booking to that paymentOption; the link already texted stays the same and opens with the new choice, so nothing new is sent. Only an option the trip lists

tools.name: update_travellers
tools.description: Correct who is travelling on a booking the traveller has not paid for yet: a passenger's name or date of birth (names exactly as on the passport, dates YYYY-MM-DD). Give only what changes, by position: { passenger: 2, name: "Sophie Hougham", dateOfBirth: "1990-04-12" }. What you leave out stays as i

tools.name: resend_link
tools.description: When the traveller says the secure link has not arrived, or asks for another: Vuelo texts it again, to the same number. The first time it resends the same link; after that, once it has been opened, or once it has expired, Vuelo cancels it and texts a fresh one, and only the newest works. Never pass

tools.name: send_to_payer
tools.description: After a booking has started, when the traveller says someone else is paying (a friend, a partner, a parent, their company); if you know before booking, pass payer to book_trip instead. tools.description: Cancel a Vuelo booking, before or after the traveller confirms. Pass the taskId if it was made in this conversation; from any other conversation, a made booking can be cancelled with its Vuelo reference (VU-...) and the email or mobile it was booked with. Not confirmed yet: it is called off at once,

tools.name: contact_support
tools.description: Send the traveller's request to Vuelo's support team, who will be in touch with them. tools.description: Where a request to Vuelo's support team stands: with the team, replied (the reply is in the traveller's email), or resolved. Pass the ticket reference (SUP-...) and either the taskId of the booking in this conversation or the email the traveller gave. Use it when the traveller asks for an update. To

tools.name: get_booking_status
tools.description: The current state of a Vuelo booking started with book_trip. Pass wait_seconds (up to 50) straight after the traveller has the link: it answers the moment they open it, pay or cancel, so you can tell them it is booked without being told.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "cancel_booking" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

evidence.snippet: taskId, reference, email, mobile, preview, code

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_trips, book_trip, cancel_booking, find_my_booking, get_support_ticket · Private data: contact_support, find_my_booking · Public sink: book_trip, send_to_payer, cancel_booking, contact_support, find_my_booking, get_support_ticket · Destructive: search_trips.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_trips, book_trip, cancel_booking, find_my_booking, get_support_ticket · Private data: contact_support, find_my_booking · Public sink: book_trip, send_to_payer, cancel_booking, contact_support, find_my_booking, get_support_ticket · Destructive: search_trips

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
